That mechanical reduction does not constitute the finished transcript. The reviewed correction layer adds 386 ordered decisions, repairs public entities, isolates missing/indistinct spans, and preserves consent and health chronology that a fluent rewrite could otherwise erase. The opening is Mangchi's officially cataloged ‘When the Bullies Fall,’ not generic violent speech, but several lyrics remain non-quotation-grade.
